alt: 孩子望著玻璃櫃中的新鮮水果塔，眼睛發亮，嘴角掛著一點口水。
scene_prompt: 垂涎三尺 means intensely craving delicious food. In a neighborhood bakery, a child gazes longingly at a fresh fruit tart displayed behind glass, cheeks lifted and eyes sparkling, with a small playful glistening droplet at the corner of the mouth as gentle cartoon exaggeration. The child keeps hands at their sides and waits politely while a parent speaks with the baker; no theft and no long stream of saliva. Make the delicious tart clearly the focus. Natural anatomy with exactly two arms and two legs per person, plausible bakery counter and glass reflections, tart rests securely on a plate. Original characters.
